name: ai-work-os
description: AI Work OS - an AI operating system for teams

scripts.dev: npm run build -w @workos/shared && npm-run-all --parallel dev:shared dev:api dev:web
scripts.build: npm run build -w @workos/shared && npm run build -w @workos/api && npm run build -w @workos/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @workos/shared && npm run typecheck -w @workos/api && npm run typecheck -w @workos/web
scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.docker:reset: docker compose --profile app down -v && docker compose --profile app up -d --build
scripts.docker:seed: docker compose exec api node apps/api/dist/scripts/seed.js
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run build -w @workos/shared && npm run infra:up && node scripts/wait-for-infra.mjs && npm run migrate && npm run seed
